name: GitHatHook
description: A pool only named programs may trade on, each swap up to a fixed size. A swap is let through only when it comes from an executor named at deployment and requests at most the limit of the input currency; exact-output swaps are refused. The limit is per swap, not a budget. Adding and removing liquidity and donating are open to anyone. It moves no funds and has no owner.

reasons: No dynamic fee and no returns-delta flag, so a general router finds the pool.
But every swap that does not come from a named executor is refused, so a general router cannot trade on it.
The 0x91 address-prefix rule applies to a deployed address. This hook is not deployed.

pool.binding: None. Any pool may name this hook.
pool.fee: Any. The hook does not read or set the fee.

math.expression: allowed when -amountSpecified <= maxInput, for an exact-input swap

deltas.returns: BeforeSwapDelta 0, fee override 0, or a revert

securityAssumptions: Assumes the v4 `PoolManager` is the only caller of the callbacks (enforced by the `onlyPoolManager` modifier inherited from `BaseHook`).
Assumes the executors named at deployment are what they are meant to be: they are part of this hook's security boundary.
doesNotGuarantee: Does not cap what an executor trades over time: the limit is per swap and may be used again in the next call.
Does not know the value of the input: the limit is a number of units, the same for either currency.
Does not gate liquidity or donations.
Does not allow exact-output swaps at all.

invariants.statement: The hook's address carries exactly the permissions it declares: beforeSwap, mask 0x80.
The constructor rejects an address with one bit different.
A swap from a named executor up to the limit goes through.
A swap above the limit, from anyone else, or exact-output, is refused.
The limit is per swap: the same executor may use it again.
A swap goes through exactly when it requests no more than the limit.
